# Zhao Haiying Law | 赵海英律师

> Cross-border inheritance, overseas divorce, cross-border family law, asset repatriation, apostille, wills and estate planning for overseas Chinese and international clients. | 赵海英律师团队专注涉外继承、跨境婚姻家事、资金出境、海牙认证、涉外遗嘱与财富传承，服务海外华人、在华外籍人士和跨境家庭。

The main website is available at: [zhaohaiyinglvshi.com](https://zhaohaiyinglvshi.com/)
